01 · Board released

The hidden cost of manual board transfer

Hand-carrying boards is quietly taxing your line

Every walk, every dropped board and every missed hand-off costs money. Conveyorized board handling changes that math.

Operators as board couriers

Carrying boards between machines by hand wastes operator time and breaks the line flow.

Boards dropped and damaged

Manual transfer drops, scratches and bends boards — defects you can trace to handling.

Line stoppage at every hand-off

Without a handshake, machines wait or push boards into each other.

Cycle-time mismatches

When one machine is faster than the next, boards pile up or starve the line.

Off-the-shelf that does not fit

Standard conveyors ignore your rail widths, board sizes and line layout.

Unplanned downtime

Poorly designed transport creates jams and missed stops that stall the line.

Equipment options & selection guide

Choose the right conveyor for your line

Conveyors are configured to your line layout. Use the guide below to pick the base type, then we confirm the details with a free layout review.

Selection guide

Match the conveyor to your process
Standard rail conveyor (接驳台)Single or double rail, belt or roller; lengths 0.5–2 m. Use between printers, mounters, ovens and testers to carry boards automatically.
Buffer conveyorAdds queue capacity between machines with different cycle times. Use when one machine runs faster than the next and boards must wait.
Dual-link conveyorTwo parallel lanes. Use for double-track lines or to separate OK / NG boards.
Flat belt conveyorESD belt transport for boards and carriers. Use for gentle, high-volume transfer between line stages.
Options & accessoriesLamp frame, ESD worktable, stop / detection sensors, SMEMA interface, stepper or PLC drive, custom rail width and working height.

Installation guide

Install and commission in a day

Reference procedure based on the Southern Machinery S-460C rail conveyor manual. Full documentation is provided with the machine.

01 · Site preparation

Place the conveyor on a level floor in line with the adjacent machines. Confirm power supply and, if used, air supply are available at the position.

02 · Level & align

Adjust the support feet so the conveyor rail height matches the upstream and downstream equipment (reference working height 900 ± 20 mm).

03 · Power & signals

Connect the power cable. Wire the SMEMA handshake: front and rear board-present signals (e.g. Y2/CM2, X1/GND on the S-460C) to the adjacent machines.

04 · Belt & rail check

Check belt tension and tracking; set rail width to your board size. Verify the stop and detection sensors respond to a test board.

05 · Test run

Switch on POWER, run in Normal (manual) mode, then switch to Bypass (automatic) and confirm the board transfers board-to-board without jams or missed stops.

Technical evaluation FAQ

Questions buyers ask before ordering

Which conveyor type do I need?

Standard rail conveyors connect two machines; buffer conveyors add queue capacity when cycle times differ; dual-link conveyors serve parallel lanes or OK / NG separation; flat belt conveyors suit gentle high-volume transfer. Send your line layout and we recommend the right type.

How is the conveyor controlled?

Reference models use PLC or stepper drive with a POWER switch and Normal / Bypass (manual / automatic) mode. Boards stop on the rear sensor until the next machine is ready, then transfer automatically.

What is SMEMA?

SMEMA is the standard board handshake between SMT machines: board-present signals pass upstream and downstream so boards transfer without collisions. The S-460C reference uses Y2/CM2, X1/GND and Y3/COM3, X2/GND signals.

What sizes are available?

Standard conveyor lengths are 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.8 / 1 / 1.2 / 1.5 / 2 m with custom rail widths; the S-460C reference handles boards from 50 × 50 to 460 × 460 mm at 900 ± 20 mm working height.

How long does installation take?

With the reference S-460C procedure, a standard conveyor is leveled, wired, belt-checked and test-run within a day — site prep, alignment, power and SMEMA signals, belt check, then a Normal / Bypass test run.

How do I get a price and delivery time?

Email info@smthelp.com or WhatsApp +86 136 0256 2576 with your board sizes, line layout and quantity. Quotation and delivery schedule are provided after technical confirmation — typically the same working day.
